name: prompt-enhancer
description: '++ <request>': Claude checks your request for gaps and restates it before any work. '++goal' (or '++g') and '++loop' (or '++l'): Claude drafts a checkable /goal with a printed turn cap, or a safe, self-stopping /loop, and the card flags what the goal judge cannot check. No extra model calls. '== <text>' or /grammar: checks only your grammar with one small Haiku call; nothing is sent to Claude. Switch it off in /config.

grammar.title: Grammar check (== and /grammar)
grammar.description: on: '== <text>' and /grammar check only your grammar with one small Haiku call (about 1.4K tokens), and never send your text to Claude. off: '==' is sent to Claude as you typed it, and this mod makes no model call at all.
